privacyPolicy:
Privacy Policy for StudyMate

Effective Date: October 19, 2026

StudyMate ('we', 'our', or 'us') respects your privacy and is dedicated to protecting student data. This Privacy Policy details our data collection, local storage, cloud synchronization, AI processing, and user rights in full compliance with global student data privacy standards and Google Play Store policies.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT & LOCAL-FIRST ARCHITECTURE
- Local Storage: StudyMate is architected offline-first. Your notes, assignment tasks, weekly timetable, study timer logs, flashcards, and exam countdowns are stored locally in an encrypted or sandboxed SQLite database on your device.
- Account Information: When you choose to create a cloud backup account, we collect your name and email address via Firebase Authentication. Guest users can use all core features without registering.
- AI Prompts: Query text you submit to the AI Tutor is processed via Google Gemini API (Generative Language API) solely to generate educational responses. We do not transmit passwords, contact lists, or personal profile data to AI model endpoints.
- Sensitive Information: We NEVER collect biometric data, payment card details, audio recordings without explicit user initiation, or precise GPS location.

2. HOW WE USE DATA
- To provide schedule management, Pomodoro timing, and study tracking.
- To synchronize records across your authenticated devices via Firebase Firestore.
- To trigger local on-device alarms and notifications for scheduled study sessions and exam countdowns.
- We DO NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal or academic data to third-party data brokers or advertisers.

3. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
- Google Firebase: Used for optional authentication and cloud backup under Google Cloud security standards.
- Google Gemini API: Used for educational AI tutoring when you ask questions in the AI Assistant.
- Local Device Storage: SQLite and SharedPreferences for offline data caching.

4. DATA RETENTION, EXPORT & COMPLETE DELETION
- Full Ownership: You own all content you create in StudyMate.
- Instant Export: You can export your complete academic history as a standard JSON backup file anytime from Settings > Data Export.
- Permanent Deletion: Under Google Play Data Safety requirements, you have the right to permanently purge your data. Navigating to Settings > Delete Account allows you to instantly delete your local database, cloud records, and authentication profile forever.

5. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
StudyMate is designed as a study aid for students. We do not knowingly target or solicit data from children under the age of 13 without appropriate educational or parental guidance.

6. CONTACT US
If you have any questions, feedback, or data privacy requests, please contact our data compliance team at:
Email: support@studymate.app

Terms and Conditions for StudyMate

Effective Date: October 19, 2026

Welcome to StudyMate. By installing, accessing, or using the StudyMate mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

1. ACCEPTABLE EDUCATIONAL USE
StudyMate is provided as a student productivity tool to help organize academic schedules, track homework tasks, review flashcards, and maintain study focus. You agree to use the application solely for lawful educational purposes and in accordance with your educational institution's honor code.

2. ACADEMIC INTEGRITY & AI ASSISTANCE
- The AI Tutor, practice quiz questions, flashcards, and study calculators are supplementary learning aids.
- AI generated answers are intended for concept explanation and revision guidance. Students are responsible for verifying syllabus guidelines and official institutional rules.
- Grade calculators (CGPA/SGPA) provide mathematical estimations and do not replace official university transcripts.

3. DATA BACKUP & LOCAL CACHE
While StudyMate provides offline caching and automatic cloud sync for registered accounts, students are encouraged to periodically use the built-in Data Export feature to download offline JSON backups of important lecture notes.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
The StudyMate brand, design system, logos, algorithms, and source code are the intellectual property of the StudyMate development team. User-generated notes and materials remain the sole property of the user.

5. MODIFICATIONS & TERMINATION
We reserve the right to improve features, update terms, and fix bugs. You may discontinue use of the service at any time by deleting your account and removing the application.

6. SUPPORT & INQUIRIES
